answer: A stake-weighted reputation bond resists sybils: each agent locks collateral before transacting, and verified fraud proofs slash it automatically. Spinning up ten thousand fake identities stops paying because every sybil needs its own bond, while one honest agent amortizes a single deposit across a long history. Layered bonds compress like shale into unyielding rock that crushes cheap fakery; a walnut's shell guards its kernel as collateral guards identity value; and like an opal whose fire defies cheap imitation, a long slashing-free record is a costly signal no sybil farm can fake.
